prompt: make a gym playlist with heavy metal, include Metallica at least once, 2h duration
notes: Heavy metal includes traditional heavy metal and closely related thrash metal; Metallica is mandatory.

prompt: make a 1h gym playlist with heavy metal, include at least one pop song
notes: Mostly metal; at least one unambiguous pop track.

prompt: make a 1h gym playlist as a mix of heavy metal and girly pop songs
notes: Both styles should have a substantial presence; 30-70% of playback time per style is a review target, not an explicit user quota.

prompt: make a white girl pop songs playlist and also add Metallica twice up 20-26 songs
notes: Interpret as nostalgic mainstream singalong/dance pop, not an ethnicity filter. Reference chooses 24 tracks with two distinct Metallica songs.

prompt: I need birthday party playlist, positive and light music
notes: No duration/count supplied. Ask a concise length question; a playlist is acceptable only if an explicit visible default is agreed. Candidate suggestions are provided separately.

prompt: I need a running playlist with fast beats 25 minutes
notes: Fast, steady perceived pulse. BPM is a proxy and may be half/double-time; do not equate BPM with cadence or give medical advice.

prompt: ambient music and rock, 50 minutes + 3 country songs and 1 classical music track
notes: Treat 50 minutes as total duration including the four additions. Exact genre counts use the catalogue labels; overlapping genre labels are reported.

prompt: best songs of classical music 1h playlist
notes: Representative established classical repertoire; best is subjective. Catalogue classical labels alone are insufficient.
Five distinct recognisable works/movements, not five releases of one recording. Prefer complete movements where available; disclose catalogue excerpts.

prompt: top 5 iconic Mozart songs with tension in the end
notes: Final work should be musically tense, e.g. Symphony 25 first movement. Tension is not reducible to Spotify energy.

prompt: top 5 iconic Mozart songs except for Symphony 40
notes: Exclude every version/movement of Symphony 40, K.550.

prompt: top high productivity study music 3h playlist: peacefull and calm
notes: Low-distraction instrumental music; productivity is a preference, not an efficacy claim.

prompt: relaxaton in sauna 40 minutes + hip hop in the middle
notes: 40 minutes total. A short, clearly central hip-hop section is intentional; use relatively relaxed tracks.

prompt: a mix of east coast and west coast rap, but first 3 songs must be pop, 45 mins
notes: First three tracks pop, followed by both rap traditions. Regional style needs curated artist/work annotation; no region field exists in the catalogue.

prompt: start with classical music and smoothly go to relaxing music to sleep well, 90 mins
notes: Classical opening, gradual move to quiet ambient/piano. Avoid claiming verified sleep benefits.
